response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with a strong web/full-stack, DLang, and JavaScript/TypeScript background, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no significant recent hands-on C++ development (only a brief C/C++ stint in 2014-2015), no Windows platform experience evident, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains
Strong systems/low-level background (DLang, C, embedded, performance-focused work)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: No substantial C++ experience (only ~6 months in 2014-2015), far short of the 5-10 years required
No evidence of Windows platform development; career is Linux/cloud/web-centric
Zero exposure to fixed income, capital markets, investment banking, or financial-services domains

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income/investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated Windows or SQL Server/Oracle experience
